title: Barriees befall Walls Bound But quickly Footprints and fungus Fold under epiphanies found In Time's fickle Friction Fixated on Realities' Broken Dicti
summary: Barriees befall Walls Bound But quickly Footprints and fungus Fold under epiphanies found In Time's fickle Friction Fixated on Realities' Broken Diction Spoken maladies dance with Token casualities Casting reason On FORWARD #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Barriees
befall
Walls Bound
But quickly
Footprints
and fungus
Fold under
epiphanies
found In
Time's fickle
Friction
Fixated on
Realities'
Broken Diction
Spoken
maladies dance with
Token casualities
Casting reason

On

FORWARD

#smallpoems
